svg.text: SEVAFORGE v3.0 — AI-Augmented Platform Engineering CLI · Architecture & Request Flow
Source: sevaforge_unified/forgeflow/ (core/mission_control.py, core/model_router.py, core/rag_pipeline.py, agents/*, mcp_servers/*)
Developer entry points · CLI commands · CI/CD hooks · IDE extensions
Rich CLI output · HTML reports · sevaforge.io
Rich terminal · HTML artifacts · SVG architecture
Command parsing · --mode local|cloud · --ai flag · Stage sequencing · Approval gates (bridge) · Pre-push deploy pipeline
discover → normalize → docs → iac → cd → ci → e2e → review → test → scan │ deploy-intent → deploy-design → deploy-validate
Python 3.9+ · MissionControl class · MCPOrchestrator · Intelligence Maturity engine · TrustScore routing
Each agent: deterministic execute() ALWAYS works · LLM execute_with_llm() is optional upgrade · Persona agents for deploy design
5 · AI GATEWAY — ModelRouter + RAG Pipeline (core/model_router.py · core/rag_pipeline.py)
Single chokepoint for all LLM traffic · model abstraction · cost controls ($0.10/call, $5/run cap) · hybrid search · trust-gated activation
Reached only through AI Gateway (Layer 5) · cost-capped · retry with backoff
JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol · Local subprocess per server · Cloud fallback via forgeflow-config.yaml
Stateful tier — RAG collections, feedback signals, run history, deployment artifacts
Local: Python subprocess · Cloud: GKE / Docker · IaC: Terraform · CI/CD: GitHub Actions · Monitoring: Prometheus + Grafana

g.text: Nexus → SevaForge mapping: Nexus is a cloud AI-PaaS serving Deltek product chatbots. SevaForge is a CLI-first platform engineering tool that developers run locally.
Both share: layered architecture (gateway → orchestrator → agents → AI → data), MCP protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0), model routing (Claude + cost-aware fallbacks),
hybrid vector search (pgvector + keyword), trust-gated AI (Nexus: agent catalog + DELA brain / SevaForge: TrustScore ≥80 → LLM path).
Key difference: Nexus routes product chatbot requests through Traefik → DELA → MCPs. SevaForge routes developer CLI commands through Click → MissionControl → 14 pipeline agents → MCP servers.
